description: Fuzzy mixed integer linear programming model for monthly unit commitment in the national level power system is a model or code deposit deposited in NRCT Data Center by its authors Truong Quynh Hoa. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
